name: swanson
about: oak planks drop in, pixel-art Ron Swanson slides up on the right, and one of his quotes burns into the wood beside him; then a saw cuts it all away

licence.assets: none: Ron and the wood are drawn in code. The quotes come from the Ron Swanson Quotes API. Ron Swanson is Parks and Recreation's (NBC), played by Nick Offerman: an unofficial fan tribute, for our own kiosks
